primary.description: LM Studio with Nomic embeddings - high quality for semantic search

setup: 1. Edit this file to configure your preferred embedding providers
2. Change 'primary' to your preferred embedding service
3. For Ollama: Make sure model is pulled (ollama pull qwen2.5:1.5b)
4. For LM Studio: Load an embedding model and update base_url if needed
5. For OpenAI: Add your API key

providers.lm_studio: Default Friday provider with good quality embeddings
providers.ollama: Fast local embeddings, good for development
providers.openai: High quality but requires internet and API costs
